summary: This Phase 1 study compared how well the body absorbs two different tablet combinations used for type 2 diabetes mellitus. The trial included 40 healthy adult participants to see how the test tablets stacked up against Glyxambi. Humanis Saglık Anonim Sirketi sponsored the research, which has been completed. Researchers measured how much of the drugs entered the bloodstream over 72 hours while volunteers were fasting.
